collision_boundary.C206: C206 studies Couette advection-diffusion Fourier shearing on T times R; C299 classifies radial nonlinear-vorticity self-similarity on R^2, whose advection cancels geometrically.
collision_boundary.C207: C207 classifies Barenblatt profiles for scalar nonlinear diffusion; C299 reconstructs velocity by Biot-Savart and audits circulation, particle angles, enstrophy, and the point-vortex boundary.
collision_boundary.energy_warning: nonzero circulation gives logarithmically divergent whole-plane kinetic energy; only enstrophy and palinstrophy are claimed finite.

boundary_rows.statement: Gamma=0 gives omega=u=0 for every positive age.
tau_0>0 gives a smooth finite-enstrophy initial profile.
tau_0=0 starts from Gamma delta_0 weakly and is smooth only for t>0.
the classical Gaussian theorem assumes nu>0.
as nu decreases to zero, omega converges weakly to Gamma delta_0 and u converges off the origin to the point vortex.
the continuous velocity extension fixes the particle at r=0.
for Gamma nonzero and r>0, theta(t)=Gamma log(tau)/(8 pi nu)+O(1).
for Gamma nonzero every finite p>1 norm decreases strictly with age, excluding recurrent vorticity states.
for Gamma nonzero the whole-plane kinetic energy diverges logarithmically at spatial infinity.

model.closure: div u=0 and curl u=omega with zero radial velocity
model.equation: partial_t omega + u dot grad omega = nu Delta omega on R^2
model.normalization: integral over R^2 of omega equals Gamma

nonclaims: No target arithmetic local datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, or zero match is asserted.
The circulation Gamma and Gaussian moments are fluid-mechanical source data, not rational-prime labels or prime-power weights.
The Navier-Stokes generator is not asserted to be a Hilbert-Polya operator.
No literature priority is claimed for the classical Lamb-Oseen formula or its standard radial reduction.

proof_contract.dissipation: polar Gaussian integrals give all moments, Lp norms, enstrophy and palinstrophy
proof_contract.finite_role: finite rows regress formulas and boundary conventions; the global theorem is analytic
proof_contract.normalization: finite circulation fixes the remaining Gaussian constant
proof_contract.radial_reduction: radial vorticity has tangential Biot-Savart velocity, so u dot grad omega vanishes identically
proof_contract.uniqueness_ode: the similarity ODE integrates to nu xi F'(xi)+(xi^2/2)F(xi)=C; regularity at xi=0 forces C=0

theorem_contract.boundaries: zero circulation, measure-valued zero-age start, inviscid weak limit, fixed origin, logarithmic angular drift, and infinite kinetic energy are separated
theorem_contract.classification: every bounded-at-origin finite-circulation C2 radial forward self-similar profile is the signed Gaussian Lamb-Oseen profile
theorem_contract.dissipation: enstrophy=Gamma^2/(8 pi nu tau) and palinstrophy=Gamma^2/(16 pi nu^2 tau^2)
theorem_contract.lagrangian: each positive radius is invariant and its continuous real-lift angle is an exponential-integral difference
theorem_contract.moments: integral |x|^(2k) omega dx=Gamma k! (4 nu tau)^k for every integer k>=0
theorem_contract.velocity: u_theta=Gamma(1-exp(-r^2/(4 nu tau)))/(2 pi r), continuously extended by u(0,t)=0
